scope: Per-alert evidence and intended actions, not a claim that GitHub state or final CI already passed. Verify the resulting source commit and live fixed/dismissed states after submission. No blanket rule/path exclusions, no deletion or rewriting of original scans, no human independent-review claim and no general risk acceptance.

alerts.justification: The complete request URI is prefixed with the operator-configured Agent origin. Real two-origin HTTP regressions prove hostile paths/queries retain that origin and both proxy overloads do not follow cross-origin redirects or disclose the Bearer token. Applies only to these exact source and test bytes.

The actual SecurityConfig accepts JWT credentials only from an explicit Authorization header. RSA/Nimbus verified regressions show cookies, authenticated sessions, query and form credentials cannot authorize a mutation; a header-authorized request creates no authentication session. Applies only to this exact authentication configuration.
